name: Calliope Sales Workspace
author: Maira Foresto

sections.description:
Calliope Sales Workspace gives small businesses, freelancers and sales teams a practical place to manage everyday sales work inside WordPress.

Instead of jumping between spreadsheets, notes and disconnected files, you can keep your clients, products and quote documents organized from the same admin area you already use.

The free plugin focuses on the essentials: a simple CRM-style client list, a lightweight product catalog and quote documents you can create, edit, view and print.

What you can do with the free plugin

  • Manage clients with company/name, email, phone and notes.
  • Search and organize your client list from WordPress.
  • Create and maintain a basic product catalog.
  • Add product name, price, category and active/inactive status.
  • Create quote documents connected to clients and products.
  • Edit quantities, prices, totals and internal quote details.
  • View, print or save quote documents from the browser.
  • Keep the workflow simple, fast and easy to understand.
  • Use the plugin without artificial limits on clients, products or quotes.

Built for real sales work

Calliope Sales Workspace is designed for people who need a useful sales tool, not a bloated platform.

It is a good fit for:

  • Web agencies that prepare quotes for clients.
  • Local businesses that sell products or services by quotation.
  • Freelancers who want a cleaner sales workflow inside WordPress.
  • Small teams that need a shared place for clients, products and quotes.
  • WooCommerce site owners who want a more sales-focused workspace around their catalog and customers.

Why this plugin is different

Many CRM plugins are too complex for small teams. Calliope Sales Workspace keeps the free experience focused on the tasks that matter most:

  • Add the client.
  • Add or select products.
  • Create the quote.
  • Review the total.
  • Print or save the document.
  • Keep the record inside WordPress.

No unnecessary setup. No artificial free limits. No complicated onboarding.

Optional Pro add-on

Calliope Sales Workspace Pro is an optional separate add-on available from CalliopeWP.

The Pro add-on is intended for teams that need more advanced workflows, such as enhanced quote actions, custom branding, professional printable documents, CSV import/export, WooCommerce-connected product workflows, product images, sales rep tools, client assignment tools, WhatsApp/email sharing and sales team reporting.

The free plugin remains fully functional for basic clients, products and quotes management.

External services

The free plugin does not connect to external services automatically and does not send your site data to third-party services for its core functionality.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate Calliope Sales Workspace.
  3. Open Calliope Sales Workspace in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Add your first client.
  5. Add products or services.
  6. Create your first quote.
sections.faq:
Does the free plugin have limits for clients, products or quotes?

No. The free plugin does not add artificial limits for basic clients, products or quotes.

Can I use it without WooCommerce?

Yes. The free plugin can be used as a standalone sales workspace inside WordPress.

Can I print or save a quote as PDF?

Yes. Quotes include a browser-based view/print screen. You can print the document or save it as PDF using your browser.

Does the free plugin require an external service?

No. The free plugin works inside WordPress and does not require external services for its core functionality.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes. Calliope Sales Workspace Pro is a separate optional add-on for advanced workflows. The free plugin remains fully usable on its own.

Who is this plugin for?

It is built for small businesses, freelancers, agencies and sales teams that want a simple way to manage clients, products and quote documents inside WordPress.
